notes.title: Released patch 1.1
notes.notes:
- Added intermediate save checkpoints on the levels.
- Avatars in the leaderboard are now displayed correctly.
-  Fixed a bug that did not allow you to view the final statistics at the 4th level of the second episode.
- Minor bugs fixed.

notes.title: Game Improvements
notes.notes:
During the last days, just before the release we were working hard to make the game even better. We have made improvements related to game optimization, added more items to the store and slightly modified the balance of the game. We also added a couple of new enemies.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32288210/af06cd7e77520aaaccd46ca517e7aecf4f2ce5ce.png[/img]
